description: The connected app's own learned skills, checkpoints and metrics: how the AI works, not project facts (those go in log_work). learn: save a skill. list: a project's and global skills. confirm: one more session where it held (promoted after 3 at a 0.8 rate). save_state / get_state: a checkpoint. log_metric / list_metrics: scores. Reads: list, get_state, list_metrics; the rest only add rows or counts. Returns rows.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

context.description: learn: when it applies. log_metric: where it was scored.

focus_summary.description: save_state: what the session was doing.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

project.description: Project name or id. Required except for list and list_metrics; list adds global skills.

skill_type.description: learn (required) / list (filter): the kind of skill.

tool_name.description: learn: the related tool. list: filter.

name: manage_skills
